'''Ianor''' is a soldier from [[Shienar]].

== Appearance ==
His hair is in a topknot.

== Activities ==
Ianor and four other Shienarans meet with [[Lan Mandragoran]]'s company on the border of [[Arafel]]. He wants to join Lan on his quest and is only allowed to if he keeps Lan's identity a secret.

== Trivia ==
* Ianor is named for Ian Norris, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
